name: features-section-demo-3

frames.best_why: Frame 2 shows the section heading with both top bento cards, bridge photo and photo stacks.

tagline: A bento feature grid mixing a bridge photo, stacked snapshots and a globe.
summary: A wide bento layout under a centred heading. One large card holds a sunset bridge photo, a narrow card shows tilted stacks of small photos, and the lower row pairs copy panels with a slowly turning globe.
appearance: A dark bento grid beneath a centred heading. A wide card holds a large sunset photo of the Golden Gate Bridge, a narrower card to its right shows tilted stacks of small photos, and lower text panels sit beside a glowing globe that peeks from the edge.
behaviour: The layout holds still; hovering a small photo in the stack scales it up, and the globe turns on its own in a continuous loop. Nothing else shifts.
demo_content: Heading "Packed with thousands of features" with cards for issue tracking, AI photos, YouTube and deploys.
search_phrases: product features with photos and globe
section with photo stacks and text
features page with a rotating globe
use_when: A product page wants a varied bento section mixing photos, copy and a live globe.
avoid_when: It loads several large remote images plus a canvas globe, so it is media-heavy and needs desktop width.
customise: Nothing is exposed by the section; titles, copy, image URLs and globe markers are fixed inside its skeleton components.
weight_why: A canvas globe repaints every frame alongside several large remote photos.

a11y.note: The globe canvas has no label and spins continuously, and photo alts are generic, such as "bali images" and "header".

issues: The globe sits half off its card and is cut off at the bottom.
Photo alts are generic ("bali images", "header") and describe nothing.
Several large remote images plus a WebGL globe make the section heavy.
polish_why: Bento variation and a strong bridge shot; the cropped globe and generic alts are rough edges.
title: Bento Feature Section
